Chapter 1156 - 20: Inconceivable Strength (Bonus Update, Seeking Monthly Votes At The Start Of The Month)

Chapter 1156: Chapter 20: Inconceivable Strength (Bonus Update, Seeking Monthly Votes at the Start of the Month)

"Is it the Dark Sky Palace?"

Lin Yuan sensed the source of the space-time fluctuations, and by comparing it with the beast skin map, he made a judgment in his heart.

The Dark Sky Palace is a crucial place in the Xuanhuang Universe, where the Dark Sky Heart is nurtured, a supreme treasure of the Absolute Great Saint level.

Ever since Lin Yuan entered the Xuanhuang Universe, aside from the nearly three-meter Life Divine Stone, all the treasures and wonders he acquired were at the Chaos Great Saint level or below.

As for the Absolute Great Saint?

Even when the Profound Xuanhuang lineage was still present, there were not many supreme treasures at the Absolute Great Saint level, mostly found in the inner and deep regions of the universe.

"With my current strength..."

Lin Yuan felt a slight movement in his heart.

Before entering the Xuanhuang Universe, Lin Yuan formulated routes according to the beast skin map, without considering the Dark Sky Palace as a stopover.

This was because the outside of the Dark Sky Palace was filled with Dark Sky Power, a force even stronger than Futu Power; with Lin Yuan’s strength at the time, attempting to enter the Dark Sky Palace required a considerable amount of time.

Therefore, Lin Yuan did not consider it.

Compared to the Dark Sky Palace, Lin Yuan was more concerned with the tomb in the deepest part.

But circumstances have changed.

Back then, entering the Dark Sky Palace was quite difficult for Lin Yuan, but now?

After practicing "Infinite Void" to the second layer, Lin Yuan’s strength soared comprehensively, and the Dark Sky Power, which could have stopped him momentarily, now poses little threat.

And according to the space-time fluctuations emanating from the Dark Sky Palace at this moment, it is evidently emerging. If Lin Yuan doesn’t go now, it will surely attract other Great Saints.

Powerful figures such as Black Light Great Saint and Dual Origin Great Saint have the ability to enter the Dark Sky Palace, albeit with more time spent.

"I will make a trip."

Lin Yuan’s mind slightly moved, and the Taiyang Divine Spirit emerged, allowing him to follow the established route towards the depths of the Xuanhuang Universe.

As for Lin Yuan’s true self, he immediately swiftly traversed toward the direction of the Dark Sky Palace.

The second layer of "Infinite Void" brought comprehensive enhancement to Lin Yuan, not only improving the true self but also significantly enhancing the two Primordial Spirits.

Now, the strength of the Taiyang Divine Spirit is stronger than Lin Yuan’s true self before entering the Xuanhuang Universe.

...

"This time, really screwed by that Dual Origin."

Black Light Great Saint’s face was gloomy as he quickly advanced towards the depths of the Xuanhuang Universe.

Being the tenth to enter the Xuanhuang Universe, Black Light Great Saint had few choices and could only immediately proceed towards the depths of the Xuanhuang Universe.

Along the way, there was no time to carefully check, resulting in a complete lack of gain up till now.

The mighty Chaos Great Saint, a strong figure among Chaos Great Saints, having entered a postnatal universe without any notable achievements, was unacceptable to Black Light Great Saint.

"Dual Origin fellow is certainly hateful, but he..."

Black Light Great Saint thought of Lin Yuan. If it wasn’t for Lin Yuan, he would at least have been the third to enter the Xuanhuang Universe.

"Damn it, where the hell did he come from?"

Black Light Great Saint felt furious, although Lin Yuan’s final slap sent him flying, Black Light Great Saint suffered not a single bit of injury.

Through this strike, Black Light Great Saint judged that Lin Yuan’s strength should be similar to his, on the same level.

"Hmm?"

At that moment, Black Light Great Saint’s expression changed, sensing a rich space-time fluctuation.

"It’s there..."

Black Light Great Saint looked over, feeling slightly exhilarated.

Such rich space-time fluctuations belong to anomalies produced when a supreme treasure appears in the four-way space-time of the universe.

"The space-time rules compression in this postnatal universe is extremely high, yet still, such dense space-time anomalies occur..."

"An Absolute Great Saint level supreme treasure, definitely an Absolute Great Saint level supreme treasure!"

Black Light Great Saint unhesitatingly headed toward the source of the space-time fluctuations.

An Absolute Great Saint level supreme treasure, even Absolute Great Saints would fight wholeheartedly for it. If he, as a Chaos Great Saint, obtained it, he could trade it with an Absolute Great Saint even if he didn’t need it.

...

"This space-time fluctuation..."

In another direction, Dual Origin Great Saint transformed into a blue-gray light and suddenly stopped, "An Absolute Great Saint level supreme treasure."

"Even though the creator of this postnatal universe was once close to the Invincible Great Saint, possessing Absolute Great Saint level supreme treasures would not be many either."

Dual Origin Great Saint thought secretly, hesitated only for a moment before heading to the source of the space-time fluctuations.

Without knowing whether there are other Absolute Great Saint level supreme treasures deep within the universe, Dual Origin Great Saint naturally did not want to give up the supreme treasure at the current source of space-time fluctuations.

...

"That is..."

Great Saints like Tian Lu Great Saint, Nine Phoenix Great Saint, and Shadow Demon Great Saint also sensed the sweeping space-time fluctuations and recognized that a supreme treasure at the level of Absolute Great Saint was about to emerge.

"Such a supreme treasure..."

Tian Lu Great Saint, Nine Phoenix Great Saint, and other powerful figures did not hesitate and immediately headed toward the source of the space-time fluctuations.

Outside the entrance of the Xuanhuang Universe, these Great Saints did not compete with Dual Origin Great Saint, Lin Yuan, and others for entering the Xuanhuang Universe first.

Aside from the strength factor.

There’s also a crucial point —

There were no clear benefits upfront.

Who stipulated that those who entered the Xuanhuang Universe first would definitely have gains?

Moreover, whether this postnatal universe contained treasures worth their desperate effort to fight for still remained uncertain.

As Chaos Great Saints, they exist as entities who won’t act without clear benefits—expecting them to fight desperately without perceived gains?

But now.

This level of space-time fluctuation undeniably signifies the emerging treasure has reached the level of Absolute Great Saint.

An Absolute Great Saint level supreme treasure is enough for these Chaos Great Saints to fight desperately.

In the presence of such treasure, even newly-promoted Great Saints like Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint dare to compete with Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint.

...

Farther away, several Chaos Venerables also sensed the space-time fluctuations.

"A supreme treasure, absolutely a supreme treasure."

"Unfortunately, it has nothing to do with us."

Many Chaos Venerables felt eagerness in their eyes before quickly calming down as if doused with cold water.

Newly-promoted Great Saints like Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint dare to compete with Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint because they are at the full Chaos Realm.

Even if there is a difference in strength, it’s not too big. At least for the Dual Origin Great Saint, it’s very difficult to kill a newly ascended Great Saint, as the latter is not a stone and can escape on its own.

But a Chaos Venerable?

Don’t mention those powerful Great Saints like the Dual Origin Great Saint; even a newly ascended Great Saint can effortlessly kill a Chaos Venerable.

These Chaos Venerables, if they dare to join this commotion, no matter how many lives they have, it wouldn’t be enough to escape death.

"Although it has nothing to do with us, we can get close and take a look."

"That’s right, what does such a precious treasure look like?"

Some Chaos Venerables were curious in their hearts and started approaching the source of spacetime. As long as they watched from afar without revealing the intention to compete for it, it was expected that those Great Saints wouldn’t bother them.

...

"Arrived."

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared, looking toward a palace not far away, shrouded in darkness.

At this moment, the palace was slowly emerging from the depths of spacetime, with all directions filled with the profound power of the Dark Sky.

"Normally, the Dark Sky Palace is located deep in spacetime and is hard to discover without guidance. Now that the Dark Sky Palace has voluntarily come into the world, is it because the outer spacetime of the Xuanhuang Universe is gradually collapsing, thereby affecting this spacetime?"

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

The early emergence of the Dark Sky Palace was one of the reasons he came.

If it continued hiding in the depths of spacetime, Lin Yuan could have waited and come over after leaving the tomb.

"Once it completely emerges from the depths of spacetime, I can directly take the Dark Sky Heart inside."

Lin Yuan stood still, patiently waiting.

Just at this moment.

A slight fluctuation of spacetime traversing emerged.

The Dual Origin Great Saint arrived second.

"Is it that palace?"

The Dual Origin Great Saint, without Lin Yuan’s detailed map guidance, immediately noticed the dark palace.

Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh.

Very soon.

The Black Light Great Saint and the Wild Barbarian Great Saint also successfully arrived.

Then came the Tian Lu Great Saint, Nine Phoenix Great Saint, and Shadow Demon Great Saint.

"The treasure is inside the palace."

All Great Saints stared hotly at the dark palace slowly emerging from the depths of spacetime.

"Your mastery of spacetime distortion is indeed unique, but wanting to compete with me for the treasure inside this palace is still a bit lacking."

The Dual Origin Great Saint stared at Lin Yuan and said, "The power road I wield just happens to restrain you, and if I fight with all my might, you definitely are not my match."

If Lin Yuan could be persuaded to retreat by mere words, the Dual Origin Great Saint was willing.

"Oh?"

Lin Yuan, with his hands behind his back, glanced at the Dual Origin Great Saint.

What the Dual Origin Great Saint said was true; although they hadn’t had a full-on battle outside the Xuanhuang Universe, the gray-blue power he wielded could indeed greatly disrupt spacetime.

But that’s under the condition of comparable strength.

Water can extinguish fire, but can a drop of water extinguish a fire that spans the sky?

"Wild Barbarian, why don’t you and I join forces..." The Black Light Great Saint secretly communicated with the Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

"Join forces?" The Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s heart was moved. He indeed was willing to join forces with Black Light, as the restraining power of the Black Light Domain was well known.

"Against whom?"

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint immediately responded.

"It’s him." The Black Light Great Saint thought for a moment and glanced at Lin Yuan.

The reason for choosing Lin Yuan was due to the Black Light Great Saint’s careful consideration. Lin Yuan’s abilities were similar to the Black Light Domain and could also suppress it.

This point made the Black Light Great Saint quite fearful; as for the Dual Origin Great Saint? The Black Light Great Saint had dealt with him many times and knew his methods well.

If he truly had to choose between Lin Yuan and the Dual Origin Great Saint, the Black Light Great Saint felt Lin Yuan posed a greater threat.

"Against him?"

"No problem."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint grinned and said; he also tended to strike first at Lin Yuan.

After all, among the many Great Saints present, only Lin Yuan’s details were unclear. Leaving such an Unknown strong person here, the Wild Barbarian Great Saint also had some unease.

Boom boom boom.

Just at this moment.

The dark palace not far away fully emerged from the depths of spacetime.

A dense spatial fluctuation began to spread and permeate in all directions.

"Take action."

The Black Light Great Saint immediately activated the Black Light Domain, an infinite darkness began to spread, and the Wild Barbarian Great Saint also stepped out, punching toward Lin Yuan across spacetime.

"Hmm?"

The Dual Origin Great Saint initially intended to approach the dark palace immediately but realized the actions of the Black Light Great Saint and Wild Barbarian Great Saint and immediately understood they intended to target Lin Yuan.

"Strike while he’s down."

The Dual Origin Great Saint transformed into a beam of gray and blue light and similarly pierced toward Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan stood calmly in place, glancing at several approaching auras behind.

Swoosh swoosh swoosh.

With a slight change in thought, Lin Yuan began to activate the Divine Ability ’World’.

The surrounding space-time avenue twisted entirely. At this moment, Lin Yuan’s internal universe underwent a transformation. Using the external universe formed by his internal universe, its power surged significantly.

Buzz.

The originally dual-colored Dual Origin Great Saint, under the heavy space-time suppression, was directly immobilized, his figure forced to reveal, staring incredulously at the four-way heavens and earth, "Such suppression?"

"Hmm?"

The Black Light Great Saint’s pupils shrank; at the moment of the external universe formation, his Black Light Domain began collapsing, himself also immobilized, "I can’t sense the outside spacetime?"

The same for the Wild Barbarian Great Saint; his fist halted abruptly midway, staring blankly at the surrounding spacetime.

At the center of the universe, Lin Yuan stood there, but in the view of other Great Saints, Lin Yuan had already transformed into a round of eternal Fierce Sun, continuously emitting light and heat. Where it shone, all the chaotic evolving powers of those Great Saints were collapsing.

Such a terrifying scene made the Tian Lu Great Saint, Shadow Demon Great Saint, who planned to seize the opportunity, tremble in their hearts.
